title: Adapt PNA traces and application results to scenario streams
description: Allow base PNA and application measurements, including gain compression and other trace-like results, to source deterministic complex traces, scalar summaries, and related metadata from scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: A scenario can provide channel/measurement-specific frequency axes and complex or formatted trace data; application results remain coherent with trace and marker queries; ASCII and binary formats return the same underlying sample; trigger/OPC advances data deterministically.
notes: Supersession review: scpi-303 has been redesigned to integrate PNA traces with scpi-703 from the start. Do not implement this as a retrofit. Keep it open until scpi-303 is implemented and confirms that base and application trace outputs use the shared engine; then close scpi-705 as superseded if no distinct work remains.

title: Build the deterministic scenario and queued-data engine
description: Create an instrument-neutral engine for scripted DUT scenarios and sequential measurement data, supporting scalar values, traces, tables, events, and errors.
acceptance_criteria: Scenarios define named streams with ordered samples; consumption policy supports advance-on-read, advance-on-trigger/operation, hold-last, loop, and explicit exhaustion error; reset, seed, timing, and playback position are deterministic and observable; data may be loaded from documented human-readable and binary formats.
notes: Backlog sequencing decision 2026-08-21: work immediately after scpi-701 and before any further M3 implementation. PNA data generation must consume this shared engine rather than create a bespoke one.
close_reason: Implemented and verified the generic deterministic scenario/data engine, playback policies, timing, resettable seeds, JSON/binary codecs, and observable thread-safe positions.

title: Implement reusable virtual bench composition
description: Allow users to select catalog instruments, assign resource addresses and configurations, validate conflicts, and save/load a complete bench definition.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned bench file can create multiple named instruments with model, options, address, and driver configuration; invalid addresses or configurations fail transactionally; the same file starts an equivalent bench locally or on a remote host.
close_reason: Implemented and verified versioned bench JSON, catalog-backed transactional composition, resource validation/rendering, host overrides, and rollback-safe multi-instrument socket startup.

title: Define the emulator driver and instrument catalog contract
description: Define the plug-in contract and metadata by which an instrument family advertises supported models, firmware snapshots, options, transports, commands, scenario input types, and maturity/coverage.
acceptance_criteria: The catalog can enumerate available drivers/emulators without importing UI code; each entry identifies model/firmware/options, supported resources, coverage, and scenario capabilities; adding a driver does not require modifying the bench composer core.
notes: Backlog sequencing decision 2026-08-21: work this next, before any further M3 implementation. It establishes the contract needed by scpi-703.
close_reason: Implemented and verified UI-independent driver/catalog contract, built-in PNA metadata/factory, and third-party entry-point discovery.

title: M7: Compose virtual benches and run deterministic DUT scenarios
description: Let users select supported instrument emulators, assemble and save a virtual ATE bench, and drive those instruments with deterministic scenario data before physical equipment is available. This project emulates instruments and their observable measurements; digital DUT/firmware emulation remains a separate companion project.
acceptance_criteria: A user can discover available emulator profiles, compose a multi-instrument bench, load a reusable DUT scenario, run automation locally or remotely, and obtain reproducible scalar and trace responses through normal instrument interfaces.

title: Fix active *CLS state corruption and response regression
description: The active SCPIInstrument *CLS handler clears the entire instrument state dictionary. It must clear only error/event status and must leave measurement/configuration values, command handlers, ESE/SRE masks, and the client connection usable.
acceptance_criteria: Direct and raw-socket tests set state, issue *CLS, then verify errors/events clear while values and enable masks persist and subsequent queries respond without restarting the server.
close_reason: Fixed active SCPIInstrument *CLS so it clears queued errors and ESR/STB latches without clearing instrument values or ESE/SRE masks. Added direct and raw-TCP regressions proving the same connection remains responsive after *CLS.

title: Separate and secure the web control plane
description: Remove direct unsynchronized mutation, bind locally by default, validate inputs, prevent XSS/CSRF, and authenticate remote access.
acceptance_criteria: Security tests cover mutating routes and no untrusted content is injected as HTML.
notes: Keep near the top of the queue alongside scpi-701, scpi-703, and scpi-501; security hardening must not slip behind new feature epics.
close_reason: Implemented local-only dashboard defaults, required bearer and WebSocket authentication for remote binds, CSRF checks for mutating APIs, same-origin Socket.IO, bounded validated input, serialized server and instrument mutation, browser security headers, and XSS-safe history/live rendering with security regression tests.

title: Implement VXI-11 INSTR transport, device clear, trigger, lock, and SRQ
description: Implement ONC RPC VXI-11 and bridge clear, trigger, abort, locks, status polling, and service requests to the core.
acceptance_criteria: PyVISA INSTR, device clear, serial poll, and OPC-driven SRQ integration tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented bounded ONC RPC/XDR VXI-11 core, async, portmapper, and interrupt programs; exclusive links/locks; byte-safe reads/writes; Device Clear, bus trigger, abort, serial poll/MAV, and OPC-driven SRQ. Verified with PyVISA-Py and native NI-VISA TCPIP INSTR integration tests.

title: Harden raw SCPI socket transport on port 5025
description: Implement bounded framing, configurable termination, binary-safe I/O, sessions, timeouts, shutdown, and backpressure.
acceptance_criteria: PyVISA SOCKET tests pass under fragmentation, chaining, large transfers, timeouts, backpressure, and shutdown. Each instrument permits only one active TCP session at a time; additional connection attempts are rejected or queued and cannot concurrently mutate the same instrument state.
close_reason: Implemented bounded binary-aware raw socket framing, configurable termination, standard port 5025 defaults, single active instrument sessions, idle/send timeouts, output-queue backpressure, clean shutdown, and protocol-level regression coverage for fragmentation, chaining, binary transfers, concurrency, timeouts, and shutdown.

title: Implement calibration, ECal, cal kits, cal sets, and correction
description: Model guided and unguided acquisition, standards, kits, ECal, cal-set persistence, correction, and invalidation.
acceptance_criteria: Representative SOLT, TRL, and ECal workflows complete with OPC/status behavior and alter corrected data.
close_reason: Out of scope by product decision: do not model PNA calibration, ECal, correction behavior, or calibration mathematics. Calibration/correction status will be a static always-0 response unrelated to modeled state.

title: Implement deterministic S-parameter and receiver data generation
description: Implement deterministic S-parameter and receiver-data generation as a PNA adapter over the generic scenario and queued-data engine delivered by scpi-703. PNA SDATA, FDATA, RDATA, and SNP responses must consume named scenario streams and the shared playback/advancement model from the start; do not build a standalone PNA-specific data engine that would require later retrofit. Procedural DUT models, seeded noise, and imperfections may generate samples, but they must publish through the same generic engine used by other instrument shapes.
acceptance_criteria: scpi-703 is complete first. PNA ASCII and binary arrays have correct lengths, ordering, and channel transforms while consuming the same scenario streams, advancement policies, reset behavior, timing, and deterministic seeds as non-PNA instruments. Tests prove trace selection and triggered acquisition use the shared engine, and no parallel PNA-only scenario or playback implementation exists.
notes: Design confirmed 2026-08-21: this issue owns the original PNA integration with scpi-703, not a later adapter.
close_reason: Implemented PNA SDATA, FDATA, RDATA, physical receiver, SNP, and X-axis adapters directly over the shared ScenarioPlayer; ASCII/binary formats, binding, point validation, read/trigger/operation policies, errors, seeds/reset behavior; 161/161 coverage and 243 tests pass.

close_reason: Implemented coherent linear, logarithmic, CW, power, and segment sweep state; frequency/source/receiver/IFBW/dwell controls; model limits; measurement X-axis propagation; acquisition/OPC-derived timing; expanded manifest reports to 154/154; 235 tests pass.

title: Implement asynchronous operations and OPC/WAI semantics

acceptance_criteria: OPC sets ESR only after prior work; OPC? delays response; WAI gates commands; cancellation is deterministic.
close_reason: Implemented and wired overlapped operation fences: *OPC latches SESR bit 0 only after prior work; ESE bit 0 drives ESB and SRE bit 5 drives MSS/RQS; *OPC? blocks and returns 1 without setting ESR; *WAI gates later program units; ABOR and failures resolve deterministically. Direct and raw-TCP tests pass.

title: Implement PNA existence registers and named MMEM state files
description: Implement a JSON-file-backed register store per instrument containing only channel -> trace -> measurement-type existence data. Do not store sweep parameters, hardware state, or calibration data. Add a pre-execution existence gate to the command registry: before any channel/trace/measurement-addressed command executes, verify that its address exists in the active composition; otherwise return the correct SCPI error without invoking the handler. Reuse the existing command-gating pattern used by required_capabilities in capabilities.py and registry.py, with an existence predicate instead of a capability predicate. Replace the canned pna-commands.csv responses for MMEM:STOR:STAT and MMEM:LOAD:STAT with real JSON file writes and reads. Add MMEM:CAT? to list saved JSON files for that instrument and MMEM:DEL to delete one. Non-goals: no calibration state or flag anywhere in this feature, and no replication of the real PNA internal state-file format; provide behavioral parity only by creating live state through normal channel/trace commands, saving it, recalling it, and returning the correct error when an addressed object does not exist. Numbered *SAV/*RCL registers are not part of this PNA feature; they may remain trivially accepted in the shared core for other instrument types without per-slot modeling, because non-PNA profiles are expected to use *RST plus explicit configuration.
acceptance_criteria: The per-instrument JSON store persists and restores only channel, trace, and measurement-type existence. The registry existence gate prevents handlers from running for nonexistent addressed objects and reports the correct SCPI error. MMEM:STOR:STAT and MMEM:LOAD:STAT perform real path-safe named-file operations; MMEM:CAT? lists saved JSON files for that instrument and MMEM:DEL deletes one. Save/recall round trips reproduce existence only and never calibration, sweep, or hardware state. Tests cover live create/save/delete/load, malformed and missing files, nonexistent addresses, and instrument isolation. The existing dependency on scpi-301 remains. After implementation, run tools/pna_manifest.py from the scpi-202 pipeline against the MMEM command group to identify documented MMEM commands that should be added rather than guessing.
